newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power drops weekend prices; Monday flat.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power drops weekend prices; Monday flat.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) dropped its price offers for surplus power on Saturday and Sunday, but left Monday's pre-schedulings unchanged from previous offers, the federal power marketing agency said Friday.
BPA offered firm and non-firm power at $16.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) during hours 0800 to 2300 PDT on Saturday and at $15.00 between 0900 and 2300 on Sunday.
Off-peak offers remain unchanged at $13.00 per MWh for Saturday through Monday.
Monday's peak-hour prices are steady from offers posted by BPA for most of the past week at $18.00 ($17.00 non-firm) for hours 0700-0900 and 2200-2300.
Sales offers between 1000 and 2100 PDT on Monday are still limited to 200 MW at $20.00 ($19.00 non-firm).
